name: Pixplet Media Library
author: Pixplet

sections.description:
Pixplet Media Library is a WordPress plugin that lets you search free stock photos and import images directly into your Media Library without leaving your website.

Visit Pixplet to browse free stock photos.

Find high quality free images by keyword, browse a dedicated photo library inside your admin, preview image details, and import selected images with one click. Imported images can be instantly used in posts, pages, and landing pages.

The plugin also allows you to quickly set featured images from the editor sidebar, helping you speed up content creation and publishing.

Pixplet Media Library is ideal for bloggers, publishers, businesses, marketers, and anyone who needs fast access to free stock photos directly in WordPress.

Key features

  • Search free stock photos directly inside WordPress
  • Import images into the WordPress Media Library in one click
  • Browse a dedicated Pixplet photo library in admin
  • Preview images before importing
  • Set imported images as featured images from the editor
  • Browse images by category
  • Open original image page on Pixplet
  • Store source metadata for imported images

Whether you run a blog, magazine, company website, or content platform, Pixplet Media Library helps you work with images faster and more efficiently.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/pixplet-media-library directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Media > Pixplet Library to search and import images.
  4. Open any supported post type with featured images enabled to use the Pixplet Featured Image sidebar panel.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account to use Pixplet Media Library?

No. Pixplet is free to use and does not require an account for browsing or importing images through the plugin.

Can I use Pixplet images for commercial projects?

Pixplet images are intended for personal and commercial use according to the Pixplet license terms. Please review the image page on Pixplet when you need full usage details.

Does the plugin connect to an external service?

Yes. The plugin retrieves image data from the public Pixplet API and downloads the selected image when you import it into your WordPress Media Library.

Can I set a featured image with this plugin?

Yes. Imported Pixplet images can be selected as featured images from the editor sidebar on supported post types.

What kind of websites is this plugin useful for?

Pixplet Media Library is useful for blogs, business websites, magazines, landing pages, and marketing sites that need quick access to free stock photos.
